# 12. Equatorial Meridian Survey Triumph (v12.5 oe_nav2_done_enlight soft-link resonance)
oe_sci.12 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_sci.12.t
	desc = oe_sci.12.d
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_sci_royal_society.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	option = {
		name = oe_sci.12.a
		ai_chance = { base = 70 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_meridian_resonance_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		add_research_progress = research_progress_extreme_bonus
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = capital
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_art_meridian_created }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_art_meridian_created value = 1 }
			capital = {
				create_art = {
					quality = 93
					type = work_of_art_type:oe_sci_woa_celestial_atlas
					key = oe_sci_art_meridian_star_atlas
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = capital
				current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
				capital = { NOT = { has_institution = institution:enlightenment } }
			}
			capital = {
				change_institution_progress = { type = institution:enlightenment value = 30 }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_sci.12.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		add_prestige = 18
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_meridian_resonance_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
}
